PROJECT CONTEXT

A digital experience for the work of flow control.

Max-Seal’s website is being developed around industrial valve products and their applications. The work brings product information and application context into a new digital experience. The engagement remains in progress.

01 / The design challenge

Make product and application context easier to explore.

An industrial website needs to connect what a product is with where it is used. The experience is being shaped around that relationship, helping visitors move from company context to relevant products and applications.

02 / What InnooRyze is doing

Experience design and development.

InnooRyze is designing and developing the current website build. The work connects content structure, interface design and responsive development within the Experience Design & Enablement capability.

03 / What is being built

A connected industrial product experience.

The current build presents valve products and application information through a digital experience that is still being refined. Project imagery and the interface capture show work in progress; they do not represent a completed launch.
